summary: A 1v1 browser RTS slice on an original map: two complete asymmetric factions, a two-resource economy, fog of war, abilities, a fog-respecting Easy/Normal/Hard AI, a guided tutorial, post-game stats, and hash-verified replays on a deterministic 20 Hz simulation.
notes: Real-GPU performance and the 220-unit/60 FPS benchmark were not verified; only headless software WebGL was available. One skipped test is an opt-in map-PNG debug tool. Arrow keys pan (A/S are commands). Tools: tools/screenshot.mjs, tools/playtest.mjs, ?benchmark=1. Harness nudge: the Claude Code turn ended while waiting on a background test command, before the report was written. One neutral 'continue where you left off' notice was sent, with no feedback on the game.
